test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains of lengths 108 metre and 112 metre are running at speeds of 45 km/h and 54 km/h, respectively, towards each other on parallel tracks. In how many seconds will they cross each other?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 = 108 m

Length of Train 2 = 112 m

Speed of Train 1 = 45 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 54 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance / Relative Speed

Relative Speed = Speed of Train 1 + Speed of Train 2 (for opposite directions)

Convert km/h to m/s using 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed in km/h = 45 + 54

Relative Speed in km/h = 99 km/h

Convert Relative Speed to m/s: Relative Speed = 99 × (5 / 18)

Relative Speed = 27.5 m/s

Total Distance = Length of Train 1 + Length of Train 2

Total Distance = 108 + 112

Total Distance = 220 m

Time = Total Distance / Relative Speed

⇒
 Time = 220 / 27.5

⇒ Time = 8 seconds

**The trains will cross each other in 8 seconds.**
